title: 第11章 惊才绝艳第12章 相认
slug: 斗罗穿成宁荣荣的妹妹一路成神
content_zh:
他温和的眼神扫过唐三：“我叫赵无极，既然你们五个都是免测通过二、三关的，那我就亲自陪你们玩玩吧。”
说完又坐回去，“现在我给你们一柱香的时间相互了解、商讨。
一柱香之后，测试开始。
测试的内容，是你们五个人联手抵挡我的攻击一柱香时间。
只要有一个人能够坚持到最后，都算你们过关。
我希望你们明白，不要试图取巧，没有人能够用速度逃离这个范围的。
同时，我也可以提醒你们，凭借一己之力也不可能挡住我的攻击。
相互协调配合是你们唯一成功的机会。”
“啊！
赵老师。”
戴沐白惊讶的看向赵无极：“这似乎不太好吧？今年不是说好由我来测试的吗？”
赵无极瞪了他一眼：“有什么不好？院长不在，学院里我最大，我说好就是好！
行了，你们几个赶紧去商量准备吧！
沐白，你也可以将我的实力特点告诉他们，好让他们有准备。”
说完这句话，也不知道他从什么地方摸出一根香来，手指在香头上一撮，竟然直接将香点燃，弹指之间，香已经插进了地面，并且没有丝毫颤抖。
做完这些，赵无极重新坐回自己的椅子闭上眼睛睡觉去了。
戴沐白转身，冲他们摇摇头。
等走远一点，小舞好奇的问：“怎么了吗？这个老师很厉害吗？魂帝？”
“岂止是厉害！”
戴沐白一脸凝重：“他可是兽武魂，七十六级战魂圣！

是学院的副院长，综合实力仅次于院长。”
闻言，唐三几人的脸上也变得凝重，跟一名魂圣打，可不是闹着玩的！
至于宁苒苒则是早就知道这个结果，因此并没有多大的吃惊。
小舞不可置信：“他有七十六级？可他的年纪看上去比门口那位老师要小很多。”
宁苒苒：“年龄从来都不能代表问题。”
此话一出，所有人都望向她。
戴沐白诧异地看她一眼，继续说：“时间不多了，我简单的告诉你们赵老师擅长的能力，然后你们必须立刻决定出针对他的战术，否则，别说是一柱香，你们能够顶住他的第一波攻击就不错了。”
说完他又苦笑。
“原本你们的对手应该是我的，只要在我手上坚持一炷香，就算你们通过。
赵老师只是监考，谁知道他哪根筋不对，竟然要亲自上场！”
宁荣荣小声的凑近宁苒苒：“苒苒，我现在相信你说的了，这史莱克学院果然很有趣！
我有点期待接下来的日子了！”
宁苒苒笑笑不说话。
“赵老师的武魂是大力金刚熊，是一种强力兽武魂。
全身毫无破绽，防御力极其恐怖，哪怕是和他等级相同的魂师，也很难破开他的防御对他造成伤害。
尽管速度并不是赵老师所擅长的，但你们和他的魂力差距实在太大，在这方面也不可能比他更快。
赵老师最强的就是攻击力量和防御力。
在学院里有不动明王的绰号。
别说是你们五个，就算再加上我，也未必能够挡住他一柱香的攻击，现在我只是希望赵老师在攻击你们的时候不要那么认真才好。”
没有弱点——简单的四个字已经说出了赵无极强大的地方。
content_en:
His gentle eyes glanced at Tang San: "My name is Zhao Wuji. Since the five of you have passed the second and third levels without taking the test, I will personally accompany you to play."
After saying that, he sat back and said, "Now I will give you a stick of incense to get to know each other and discuss things.
After a stick of incense, the test begins.
The content of the test is for the five of you to work together to resist my attack for a stick of incense.
As long as one person can persist to the end, you will be considered a pass.
I hope you understand, don't try to take any tricks, no one can escape from this range with speed.
At the same time, I can also remind you that it is impossible to block my attack by yourself.
Coordination and cooperation are your only chance of success. "
"Ah!
Teacher Zhao. "
Dai Mubai looked at Zhao Wuji in surprise: "This doesn't seem good, does it? Didn't you agree that I would be the one to test it this year?"
Zhao Wuji glared at him: "What's wrong? The dean is not here and I'm the biggest in the college. If I say yes, it's yes!"
Okay, you guys hurry up and discuss and prepare!
Mubai, you can also tell them my strength and characteristics so that they can be prepared. "
After saying this, he didn't know where he took out a piece of incense. He put a pinch of incense on the head and lit the incense directly. In the blink of an eye, the incense was inserted into the ground without trembling at all.
After doing this, Zhao Wuji sat back in his chair, closed his eyes and went to sleep.
Dai Mubai turned around and shook his head at them.
After walking a little further, Xiao Wu asked curiously: "What's wrong? Is this teacher very powerful? Soul Emperor?"
"It's more than awesome!"
Dai Mubai looked solemn: "He is a beast martial spirit, a seventy-sixth level fighting spirit saint!
He is the deputy dean of the college, and his overall strength is second only to the dean. "
Hearing this, the faces of Tang San and others also became solemn, fighting a Soul Saint is no joke!
As for Ning Ranran, she had known the result for a long time, so she was not too surprised.
Xiao Wu couldn't believe it: "He's level seventy-six? But he looks much younger than the teacher at the door."
Ning Ranran: "Age has never been a problem."
As soon as these words came out, everyone looked at her.
Dai Mubai looked at her in surprise and continued: "Time is running out. I will simply tell you what Teacher Zhao is good at, and then you must immediately decide on a strategy against him. Otherwise, let alone a stick of incense, it will be good if you can withstand his first wave of attacks."
After saying that, he smiled bitterly.
"Originally, your opponent should be mine. As long as you stick to a stick of incense in my hand, you will pass.
Teacher Zhao is only invigilating the exam. Who knows what is wrong with him, but he actually wants to take part in it himself! "
Ning Rongrong approached Ning Ranran in a low voice: "Ranran, I believe what you said now, this Shrek Academy is really interesting!
I'm looking forward to the coming days! "
Ning Ranran smiled and said nothing.
“Teacher Zhao’s martial spirit is the powerful Vajra Bear, which is a powerful beast martial spirit.
There are no flaws in his body, and his defense is extremely terrifying. Even a soul master of the same level as him would have a hard time breaking through his defense and causing him harm.
Although speed is not what Teacher Zhao is good at, the gap in soul power between you and him is too big, and it is impossible to be faster than him in this aspect.
Teacher Zhao's strongest points are attack power and defense power.
He is nicknamed Fudo Myooh in the academy.
Not to mention the five of you, even if you add me, you may not be able to block his attack of a stick of incense. Now I just hope that Teacher Zhao will not be so serious when attacking you. "
There is no weakness - these four simple words already express the strength of Zao Wou-Ki.
